# DeleteFile <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Files](BlitzBasic-Files)

</div>


```blitzbasic
DeleteFile:Void file:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | In | String | required | The file to delete. |

## Description

Deletes a file for good. It does not go to a recycle bin.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
file = WriteFile("files_delete_example.tmp")
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "files_delete_example.tmp"
Print FileType("files_delete_example.tmp")
```

```text
0
```
